$comment: Per-crate line-coverage floors. Checked by .github/scripts/check-coverage-floors.py against the lcov report the nightly coverage workflow emits — NEVER the PR path (see coverage.yml's header for the instrumented-double-run OOM trade). A floor change is a visible diff to this file, never a silent edit. A new crate joins in the commit that adds it. Floors were authored 2026-09-25 from a local run of the nightly's exact invocation (workspace, test-db+test-embed, --test-threads 1) at ~3 points of head-room below each crate's measured line coverage.
